sourcePolicy: Core content is authored before reference tables, slides, full-view content, formulas, and layout.

goldStandard.title: §1.1 · Vector như dữ liệu kỹ thuật

rules: Core files must not contain slide numbers, popup labels, CSS classes, layout directives, or animation instructions.
Every symbol must be defined before or when it first appears.
Every formula must include meaning, conditions, sensitivity or failure mode, and engineering use.
Every engineering vector or matrix example must define schema and units where applicable.
Subscripts and superscripts must be semantically explicit in raw notation.
Examples must distinguish algebraic correctness from modeling correctness.
Downstream presentation files may summarize the core, but may not contradict it.
